intro: A fresh daily mix for Sam: animals, birds, space and science.

animals.title: Animal Quiz
animals.description: Wild, wonderful and surprising animal facts.

questions.q: Which animal is the largest living land animal?
questions.why: The African elephant is the largest living land animal.

questions.q: Which animal is famous for changing its skin colour to help it blend in?
questions.why: Chameleons are well known for changing colour and pattern.

questions.q: What do pandas mainly eat?
questions.why: Bamboo makes up most of a giant panda’s diet.

questions.q: Which mammal can fly using true powered flight?
questions.why: Bats are mammals capable of true powered flight.

questions.q: Which animal is known for building dams?
questions.why: Beavers build dams from branches, mud and other materials.

birds.title: Bird Quiz
birds.description: Feathers, flight, nests and amazing bird abilities.

questions.q: Which bird is the largest living bird?
questions.why: The ostrich is the largest living bird.

questions.q: What covers a bird’s body and helps with flight and warmth?
questions.why: Feathers help birds fly, stay warm and protect their bodies.

questions.q: Which bird is famous for hovering while feeding from flowers?
questions.why: Hummingbirds can hover while feeding on nectar.

questions.q: Which bird cannot fly but is an excellent swimmer?
questions.why: Penguins cannot fly, but their wings are adapted for swimming.

questions.q: What do many birds use to build nests?
questions.why: Many birds combine twigs, grass, leaves, mud and other materials to build nests.

space.title: Space Quiz
space.description: Planets, stars, Moon missions and our giant universe.

questions.q: Which star is at the centre of our solar system?
questions.why: The Sun is the star at the centre of our solar system.

questions.q: Which planet is famous for its large visible rings?
questions.why: Saturn has a spectacular system of rings made mostly of ice and rocky particles.

questions.q: What is Earth’s natural satellite?
questions.why: The Moon is Earth’s natural satellite.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.why: Mars looks reddish because of iron-rich minerals on its surface.

questions.q: What force keeps planets in orbit around the Sun?
questions.why: Gravity provides the force that keeps planets in orbit.

science.title: Science Quiz
science.description: Choose a mini-world: plants, animals or our body.

questions.q: Which part of a plant usually absorbs water from the soil?
questions.why: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil.

questions.q: Which gas do green plants take in for photosynthesis?
questions.why: Plants use carbon dioxide, water and light energy during photosynthesis.

questions.q: Which body covering is typical of fish?
questions.why: Most fish have scales covering their bodies.

questions.q: Animals that eat both plants and other animals are called what?
questions.why: Omnivores eat both plant and animal foods.

questions.q: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.why: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood around the body.

questions.q: Which organ helps us breathe by taking oxygen into the body?
questions.why: The lungs take oxygen into the body and remove carbon dioxide.

questions.q: Which part of the body protects the brain?
questions.why: The skull surrounds and protects the brain.
